svg.text: the exact coordinate field of the d=12 fiducial becomes the compositum of the degree-288 ray class field two-part with the twelve magnitude double covers adjoining the square roots of the modulus S-units and with the solvable phase fields, rather than the single flat degree-288 field, because the crux coordinates z1 z3 z5 z7 z9 z11 have a magnitude that is a non-square in the ray class field and so leave it into the double cover, making the true field a controlled radical tower and not one monolithic minimal polynomial
